text:
Maria G: paging oncall — multiple customers reporting 504s from the gateway, high error rate since ~11:03 UTC. incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered (INC-4521) — paging SRE oncall.
Jon K: I'm on it. first glance, ingress proxy 504 spike, looks like a long tail to upstreams. adding traces.
Kevin S: can someone paste a sample x-correlation-id from logs? need to correlate trace.
Sara L: sample from support: x-correlation-id=7d2a9c3f. Customer says requests time out after ~30s then gateway returns 504.
Dmitri V: grabbing logs from runtime for that id. linking trace: https://dashboards.redwood/trace/7d2a9c3f (internal)
Jon K: timeline: 11:02 UTC small increase, 11:03 big spike across regions, peak 11:05–11:12, partial recovery 11:20.
Kevin S: hypothesis 1: upstream model workers overloaded -> retry amplification. hypothesis 2: LB healthcheck flapping causing connection storms.
Support Lead: impacted customers: two high-usage tenants, a production webhook batch, and some API customers on Dedicated. ticket numbers: #SUP-998, #SUP-1001.
Sara L: running a grep of 504s — most show upstream status 502/504 + repeated client retries. looks like repeated frontend retries hitting overloaded backends.
Maria G: mitigation idea: reduce gateway retry count and enable circuit-breaker for model-pool group temporarily. can we hot-patch policy?
Dmitri V: we can push a gateway config change to drop retries from 2 -> 0 for route /v1/generate, will require a rolling restart of 3/3 proxies in each AZ.
Jon K: do it. rolling restart plan: restart proxies sequentially per AZ with 60s drain. that'll avoid full outage. I'm watching latency charts.
incident-bot: Deploy started: config/gateway/retry-policy@staging -> prod (operator: Jon K).
Kevin S: while rolling, I'm increasing model-pool padding to accept more inflight on a few nodes to avoid immediate rejection. also disabling autoscale cooldown for 10m.
Sara L: pasted relevant log snippet:
```
2026-02-12T11:05:07Z gateway proxy[proxy-3] x-correlation-id=7d2a9c3f "upstream request timed out" status=504 upstream=runtime-45
2026-02-12T11:05:07Z runtime-45 model-pool[worker-12] "request queued" qlen=18 latency_ms=32000
2026-02-12T11:05:08Z runtime-12 reconnect "retrying upstream" retries=1
```
Jon K: that queue depth is concerning — model-pool worker qlen 18 and 32s latencies. confirms backpressure.
Dmitri V: also seeing downstream retries amplify qps to runtime-45 by ~2.3x at peak.
Support Lead: Customer impact: intermittent 504s for inference endpoints, elevated P50->P99 latency. Support is messaging affected customers with temporary mitigation steps (retries backoff).
Maria G: ok continue the rollout, coordinate with Support before changing anything customer-facing.
Jon K: rollout completed in us-west, us-east in progress. early metrics: 15% drop in 504s after us-west restart.
Kevin S: added short-term hotfix: decrement gateway retry header to 0 in incoming requests via lua filter, will drop extra retries until stable. Deployed to us-west+us-east.
Sara L: note — we should capture traces for failed requests for later RCA. pinned a logs query: `index=prod-gateway | where status=504 | parse x-correlation-id`
Dmitri V: snapshotting model-pool metrics and worker stacks, saved to archive: s3://redwood-incident-archives/INC-4521/metrics-11-05-11-25.tar.gz
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert status: acknowledged by Jon K.
Support Lead: customers notified: short blurb sent to SUP-998 and SUP-1001, suggested retry-backoff and temporary rate-limiting.
Jon K: current status: error rate down ~60% from peak, latency P99 improving. keeping incident open for RCA.
Maria G: next steps for RCA thread: build timeline, collect correlation ids, collect model runtime logs, check autoscaler events and kube-scheduler logs, and run hypothesis test for retry amplification vs worker starvation.
Kevin S: immediate RCA notes:
- symptom: gateway 504s and runtime queue growth starting 11:03 UTC
- probable cause: upstream worker queue overflow + client-side retry amplification
- contributing: aggressive gateway retry policy + autoscaler cooldown prevented rapid scale-up
Jon K: I'll own timeline and logs aggregation. Kevin, Dmitri, please add worker stacks and scaling events. Sara, support—compile customer impact and messages.
Support Lead: will follow up with full customer communication template in #support later today.
Maria G: thanks all. leaving this thread open for post-incident RCA. once all artifacts are in s3 we can convert to a formal postmortem. :thumbsup:
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-4521 has been resolved (ack cleared)"
